subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages, and if so under what bounds?
rationale: The code can now carry bounded historical image media, but applying it to unmentioned Telegram group traffic changes privacy, retention, and model-context exposure for messages that did not address the bot.

options.title: Approve Bounded History Images
options.body: Allow only bounded, recent, local image media from allowed group history to be replayed through the existing HistoryEntry.media path with safe path handling and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep Current Privacy Skip
options.body: Preserve the current no-download behavior for unmentioned requireMention group media and close or narrow this issue as not planned for privacy reasons.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Expose historical media replay only behind an existing or new operator-controlled policy such as ingest/ambient handling, with tests proving default behavior remains unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded History Images
recommendation.body: Allow only bounded, recent, local image media from allowed group history to be replayed through the existing HistoryEntry.media path with safe path handling and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant introduced the current Telegram unmentioned-media skip, so they are the best available routing owner for deciding whether that privacy-preserving behavior should change.
